name: Metascript Rod, Widen
body:
Aura strong (no design); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Price varies; 14,000 gp (lesser), 54,000 gp (normal), 121,500 gp (greater)

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three scripts per day that are widened as though using the Widen Script feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Widen Script; Cost varies; 7,000 gp (lesser), 27,000 gp (normal), 60,750 gp (greater)
